name: Dryground AI
summary: Full-stack AI implementation services: helps businesses design and integrate AI across their tech stack — for teams that want AI built and shipped, not just advised.
best_for: businesses that want AI solutions built for them as a services engagement rather than assembling tools themselves
skip_if: you're looking for self-serve software with published pricing — this is custom, quote-based consulting
honest_knock: This is consulting, not a tool you log into: best when you want AI designed and built for you, not when you'd rather DIY with software. Read the headline numbers carefully too. The 20-50% efficiency and 10-20% revenue figures on their homepage carry the caption “2025 industry benchmarks”, so they describe the market rather than this firm's own results. And the case studies underneath them name no clients.

pricing.notes: (2026-08-17, read in a browser because the site renders client-side and a plain fetch returns only the title) There is no public pricing anywhere, and we checked before saying so. /pricing, /plans, /services, /about and /contact all return 404. The words “pricing”, “price” and “$” appear zero times on the homepage, and the navigation carries no pricing entry at all — it runs Solutions, Products, Verticals, Case Studies, Research, Book a Consultation. Tiers do exist with no numbers attached: the AI Velocity line is described as “six tiers from pilot to full enterprise transformation” on 90-day outcome cycles. Budget this as a consulting engagement scoped per project, not a subscription you can read off a page.

cost_traps.label: Quote-only pricing
cost_traps.evidence: No public pricing anywhere: /pricing and related paths 404, no dollar amounts anywhere on the site, budgeted as a scoped consulting engagement (read 17 Aug 2026)

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
